en.headline: Customs seize 120,000 illicit cigarettes in Mong Kok flat
en.dek: Officers arrested a 46-year-old man after finding the stock in a subdivided unit used as a storage point.
body: Hong Kong Customs arrested a 46-year-old man and seized about 120,000 suspected illicit cigarettes in Mong Kok on Monday. The cigarettes have an estimated market value of about HK$540,000 and a duty value of about HK$400,000.

Choi Cheuk-fun, an investigation officer with the Customs Revenue Crime Investigation Bureau, said officers had identified a residential unit suspected of being used as a storage warehouse after days of investigation. On Monday afternoon they staked out the building and intercepted a man leaving who was believed to be connected to the unit.

Officers took the man back to the unit and found the cigarettes inside. Initial investigations showed he had deliberately chosen an older building with heavy foot traffic and rented a subdivided flat to reduce the risk of detection. Customs said the operation dismantled a storage and distribution centre active in Mong Kok. The man has been charged.
Dealing in illicit cigarettes carries a maximum penalty of HK$2 million and seven years’ imprisonment. Customs said it would continue intelligence-led enforcement against such activities.

zh.headline: 海關旺角破私煙倉 檢約12萬支私煙拘一人
zh.dek: 海關周一在旺角一割房檢獲約12萬支懷疑私煙，市值約54萬元，一名46歲男子被捕並已落案起訴。
body: 香港海關周一在旺角檢獲約12萬支懷疑私煙，並拘捕一名46歲男子。該批私煙估計市值約54萬元，應課稅值約40萬元。
海關稅務調查科調查主任蔡卓奮表示，經多日調查後鎖定一個懷疑用作私煙倉的住宅單位。周一下午人員在樓外守候，截查一名離開並相信與該單位有關的男子。
人員將男子帶回單位，發現內藏約12萬支懷疑私煙。初步調查顯示，男子刻意選擇舊樓及人流複雜的地方，租用割房作儲存點以減低被發現風險。海關指行動已瓦解一個在旺角活躍的私煙儲存及分銷中心，男子已被控。
經營、管有、售賣或購買私煙屬違法，最高刑罰為罰款200萬元及監禁7年。海關表示會繼續以情報主導打擊私煙活動。
